description: This source file implements command line interface (CLI) options handling for a Lua-based sketching environment named lu5. It defines a set of command line options ('help', 'version', 'init', 'log', 'install') along with their handlers, manages argument parsing, file operations for creating and installing sketches, and provides help and version output.

methods.name: int lu5_option_log(int argc,char ** argv,int idx,int cli_id,bool * defaultExec,char ** filename)
methods.description: Handles the '--log' command line option, parses the log level argument and sets the log level accordingly.

methods.name: int lu5_option_init(int argc,char ** argv,int idx,int cli_id,bool * defaultExec,char ** filename)
methods.description: Handles the '--init' command line option, creates a new sketch file with boilerplate content, prompts for overwrite if file exists.

methods.name: int lu5_option_install(int argc,char ** argv,int idx,int cli_id,bool * defaultExec,char ** filename)
methods.description: Handles the '--install' command line option, installs an existing sketch to system path with execute permissions, checks for hashbang.

methods.name: int lu5_option_version(int argc,char ** argv,int idx,int cli_id,bool * defaultExec,char ** filename)
methods.description: Displays the current version of lu5.

methods.name: int lu5_option_help(int argc,char ** argv,int idx,int cli_id,bool * defaultExec,char ** filename)
methods.description: Displays help information for all CLI options.
